correctness.rationale: For each real t>=1 the orthogonal coordinates x=(a-tB,-a-tB,B+b,B-b) give constant intrinsic Jacobian and exact rectangular fibers |a|<=1-t|B|, |b|<=1-|B|. Independently integrated I0=(3t-1)/(6t), IA=(5t-1)/(20t), IB=(10t^3-10t^2+5t-1)/(20t^3), I2=(5t-3)/(60t); conditional symmetry removes all mixed moments. This yields the three claimed rational intrinsic-volume covariance eigenvalues. Symbolically checked three pairwise differences, their positivity, unique least-eigenaxis crossing t=3/2 with both eigenvalues 13/35 and condition number 142/117, and volume derivative vanishing at t=2. The claimed polytope face-lattice constancy for t>1 follows from coordinate-face intersections; t=1 is a distinct octahedral endpoint. The supplied rational triangulation check was inspected, and the all-real assertion rests on the analytic integrals.
